यौवत यौवत, अम्, n. (fr. युवति), a num-
[]
ber of girls, assemblage of young women; = यौ-
तव.
यौवतेय, अस्, m. the son of a young woman.

यौवन यौवन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. युवन्), ju-
venile; (अम्), n. youth, youthfulness, the prime of
life, bloom of youth, puberty, manhood, (at the end
of an adj. comp. the fem. ends in आ, cf. प्राप्त-य्˚);
a number of young people (especially of young
women); any youthful act or juvenile indiscretion;
N. of the third grade or degree in the mysteries of
the Śāktas.
—यौवन-कण्टक, अस्, अम्, m. n.
an eruption common in youth, pimples &c. on the
face of young people.
—यौवन-दर्प, अस्, m.
the pride of youth, rashness, juvenile indiscretion or
conceit.
—यौवन-दशा, f. the period of youth.
—यौवन-पिडका, f. = यौवन-कण्टक.
—यौवन-प्रान्त, अस्, अम्, m. n. the extreme
verge or end of youth.
—यौवन-भिन्न-शैशव,
अस्, आ, अम्, whose childhood is divided by youth,
passing from childhood to manhood.
—यौवन-
मत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, intoxicated by (the pride of)
youth; (आ), f. a species of metre, four times ¯˘˘¯¯,
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯˘˘¯¯.
—यौवन-लक्षण, अम्,
n. a sign or characteristic of youth; charm, loveli-
ness, grace; the female breast.
—यौवन-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, possessing youth, being in youth, young,
youthful.
—यौवन-श्री, ईस्, f. the beauty of youth-
fulness.
—यौवन-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘being in the
bloom of youth,’ arrived at puberty, youthful, mar-
riageable.
—यौवनावस्था (˚न-अव्˚), f. the state
of youth, youthfulness, puberty.
—यौवनोद्भेद
(˚न-उद्˚), अस्, m. the ardour of youthful passion,
sexual love or inclination; Kāma-deva, the god of
love.

यौवनाश्व, अस्, m. (fr. युवनाश्व), a patro-
nymic of Māndhātṛ; a patronymic of a grandson
of Māndhātṛ.

यौवनाश्वक, अस्, or यौवनाश्वि, इस्, m. a
patronymic of Māndhātṛ.

यौवराजिक, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. युव-राज), see
Gaṇa Kāśyādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 116.

यौवराज्य, अम्, n. (fr. युव-राज), the rank or
office of a Yuva-rāja or heir-apparent associated in
the kingdom; the rights and privileges of heir-
apparent, right of succession to the kingdom.
